entry.idea: WorkFlex checks whether a company's cross-border business trips and remote work meet tax, immigration and labour rules, and produces the paperwork to prove it.
entry.lesson: Turn a scattered set of legal paperwork requirements into one automated system, and companies will pay to avoid the risk of getting it wrong.
entry.name: WorkFlex

growth.reason: Trip volume grew more than 250% year over year, a clear and very fast growth number.

market.reason: Cross-border work compliance affects any company with internationally mobile staff, a real but specialised need.

tech.reason: Its compliance risk engine covers many countries' rules, real integration work, though a strong competitor could rebuild it over time.

Amsterdam's WorkFlex Raises €37M To Expand Cross-Border Compliance Platform

entry.twist: It automates specific compliance documents, like A1 certificates and posted-worker notifications, that companies would otherwise track by hand for every trip.
entry.who_pays: Large companies with internationally mobile staff pay to manage their travel and work compliance through the platform.
entry.why_now: More people travel and work across borders, and governments are tightening enforcement of cross-border work rules just as remote work has made violations more common.
